title: The Bistro
venue_description:
The Bistro - East Bay Institution Since 1994

The Bistro located at 1001 B Street in downtown Hayward is a legendary live music venue that has been central to the East Bay music scene for over 30 years. Since 1994 it has served as Hayward's home for live music craft beer and community gathering. Known as one of the few oasis of live music in the East Bay landscape The Bistro has cultivated a reputation as a genuine neighborhood institution.

Live Music Every Day

The venue hosts live music seven nights a week with zero cover charge making it one of the most accessible live music venues in the region. Mondays feature open mic nights where local and traveling musicians perform original songs and covers. Weekends showcase jazz jam sessions blues performances and rotating local band lineups. The quality and style of music varies throughout the week but the commitment to supporting live music remains unwavering.

Craft Beer Selection

The Bistro operates as much as a craft beer bar as a music venue. Twenty craft beers on tap rotating Belgian selections and over 50 beers available to take home provide an excellent beer selection. Fine wines are available. The focus on quality craft beverages has made the Bistro popular with beer enthusiasts beyond music fans.

Atmosphere

The venue maintains a low-key casual atmosphere with paper tablecloths and crayons for patrons to draw on creating a fun interactive space. The outdoor patio provides comfortable seating. The lighting and decor feel warm and welcoming rather than pretentious. Regular patrons describe the familiar faces behind the bar as a key reason they keep returning.

Community & History

Over thirty years The Bistro has become woven into Hayward's downtown community. The venue functions as more than a bar or music venue - it is genuinely a neighborhood home away from home. Customers describe counting on the venue being there with good music and a familiar welcome. The commitment to local musicians and community values remains central to the Bistro's identity and success.
